performance.method: Three serial counterbalanced repetitions per case. Same runtime; complete game targets. Fresh grids include preparation; the River Boroughs continuation uses each implementation's own prepared but otherwise exactly equal seed. Native instruction work is deterministic. Wall-clock timings include process/input/output overhead on a shared host and are not isolated FPS or universal speedup claims. Allocation is cumulative native modeled allocation, not RSS. Route tie-breaking and cache identities may differ, so state hashes and selected outcomes are retained separately.

live.method: Serial predecessor/candidate sessions on a shared host; 500 ms requested native timer, 1024-cell detail view, per-browser native save path and autosave enabled. Exact per-cycle gameplay frames, excluding scheduling/command metadata. Not rendering FPS or an isolated hardware benchmark.
